mapper.select: SELECT m.*, c.category_name FROM medicine m LEFT JOIN medicine_category c ON m.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY m.medicine_id DESC
SELECT m.*, c.category_name FROM medicine m LEFT JOIN medicine_category c ON m.category_id = c.category_id WHERE m.medicine_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medicine (category_id, name, manufacturer, price, stock, barcode, expiration_date, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{manufacturer}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{barcode}, #{expirationDate}, 'NORMAL')
mapper.update: UPDATE medicine SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, barcode = #{barcode}, expiration_date = #{expirationDate}, status = #{status} WHERE medicine_id = #{medicineId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, c.category_name FROM medicine m LEFT JOIN medicine_category c ON m.category_id = c.category_id WHERE m.expiration_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND m.status != 'EXPIRED'
SELECT m.*, c.category_name FROM medicine m LEFT JOIN medicine_category c ON m.category_id = c.category_id WHERE m.expiration_date < CURDATE()
